senses.gloss: a Janapada of the केतुमाल country. वा. ४४. १४.

--the fifth लोक from where are born people; from root जनन;
1: Br. II. १९. १५६; २१. २२; ३५. १५३ and २०६; III. 1. १५-16; M. ६१. 1; १८४. २३; वा. १००. १२७; १०१. १७.
two crores of yojanas from Maharloka.
2: वा. १०१. १४०, २०८.

(I)--(king of मिथीला) one of the twelve sages who knew the nature of the धर्म ordained by Hari. Son of Nimi, born by churning his dead body and hence known Mithila. He was Vaideha, born of a विदेह। He founded the city of मिथिला. His son was उदावसु. Father of सीता.
1: भा. VI. 3. २०; IX. १३. १३-14; X. ७१. 9; वा. ८९. 2; Vi. IV. 5. २२-4; १३. १०३.
In his sacrifice याज्ञवल्क्य won a prize for learning while शाकल्य was humbled for pretended superiority. Father-in- law of राम.
2: Br. II. ३४. ३३-68; III. ३७. २२; ६४. 2;
In the अश्वमेध Yajn5a of his, साकल्य was [page१-623+ ३५] ruined on account of his conceit by taking part in a disputa- tion; Janaka wanted to know the best among the learned assembled and set apart ११,000 crores, much gold, villages and servants to be given as present to him; in the disputa- tion each took part but याज्ञवल्क्य ultimately threw out the challenge. साकल्य questioned this and put to him a number of questions which were all answered. याज्ञवल्क्य in his turn put him a single question, a wrong reply to it inviting instantaneous death; साकल्य agreed, and unable to answer his question, was gathered to his ancestors;
3: वा. ६०. ३२-62; ८९. 5; Vi. III. १८. ८५-90.
told by the sage Asita what the Earth narrated to him about the ignorance of kings who without subduing themselves, try to subdue others.
4: Vi. IV. २४. १२७-136.
(II)--king of Videhas, and an ally of बलराम. Welcomed बलराम to his capital. भा. X. ५७. २४-26.
(III)--a son of विशाखयूप and father of Nan- divardhana. Vi. IV. २४. 5-6.

(I)--get deserted and desolate in Kali;
1: वा. ८८. १८७.
are left in a state of अराजक।
2: Br. II. ३१. ५०, ९७; III. ५०. 5; IV. 5. 4.
(II)--the seven of क्रौञ्चद्वीप viz., उष्ण, पीवर, अन्धकार, Muni, Dundubhi, कुशल and Manuja. वा. ३३. २३.

--country people; treated with love by पृथु;
1: भा. IV. १७. 2; २१. 6; M. २२०. १५.
were provided with seats in the wrestling enclosure of कम्सा.
2: भा. X. ३६. २४.

(I)--the first of the four sons of परीक्षित् and इरावती.
1: भा. I. १६. 2; Br. III. ६८. २०.
Father of शतानीक.
2: Vi. IV. २०. 1; २१. 2-3.
Finding that the death of his father was predicted to be by the snake तक्षक, he per- formed a सर्प याग to destroy all snakes. All except Tak- [page१-624+ ३२] षक came, the latter being sheltered by Indra. At this Tak- षक and Indra were invoked together. Advised by बृहस्- pati to refrain from the cruel याग, Janamejaya agreed; with the aid of Tura, the priest, he performed अश्वमेध and other sacrifices;
3: भा. IX. २२. ३५-38; XII. 6. १६-28; M. 6. ४२.
cursed by वैशम्पायन he made याज्ञ- valkya his ब्रह्मा in a sacrifice.
4: M. ५०. ५७-60.
Introduced वाजसने- yaka and became known as Trikharvi.
5: वा. ९९. २२९, २५०-4.
Put to trouble Loha- gandha, the son of गार्ग्य out for mischief and was cursed by गार्ग्य.
6: Ib. ९३. २१.
King of सुदेश and a Kaurava; highly righte- ous. After anointing his son on the throne he went into the woods for penance.
7: M. ५०. ६१-5.
(II)--the son of Sumati; with him ended the वैशाल line. भा. IX. 2. ३६.
(III)--a son of पूरु and father of Pra- चीन्वत्. भा. IX. २०. 2; M. ४९. 1; वा. ९९. १२०. Vi. IV. १९. 1.
(IV)--the son of सृञ्जय, and father of महामनस् (महाशिल-ब्। प्।). भा. IX. २३. 2.
(V)--the son of Somadatta, and father of Sumati (Prumati-ब्र्। प्।). Br. III. ६१. १६; Vi. IV. 1. ५७-8.

(VI)--a son of Puramjaya and a राजऋषि;
1: M. ४८. १२-3; वा. ९९. १५.
father of महाशाल.
2: Vi. IV. १८. 5-6.
[page१-625+ ३८]
(VII)--a son of बृहद्रथ, entitled विश्- vajit. M. ४८. १०२.

(VIII)--a son of भल्लाट; served उग्रा- yudha in his तपस्; saved नीपस् when they were led by Yama at the behest of उग्रायुध by fighting Yama, and earned his appreciation and मुक्तिज्ञान from him as a result. Wife धूमिनी and son यवीनर. M. ४९. ५९-70; वा. ९९. १८२.
--१०० in number; according to the म्। प्। and वा। प्। ८० in number. Br. III. ६८. २०-26; ७४. २६७; M. २७३. ७१-3; वा. ९९. ४५४.

--a divine world,
1: भा. VIII. २०. ३४.
the world of वरुणा
1: a)वा. 7. २८; २३. ८४; २४. 3; ४९. १४९; ६१. १२९; ६५. १७.
as the face of विराट्,
2: भा. II. 1. २८.
and a part of पुरुष्.
3: Ib. 5. ३९.
Its inhabitants.
4: Ib. III. ११. २९.
Here was in ancient times a discussion about ब्रह्मवाद, on the occasion of a sacrifice performed by ब्रह्मा;
5: X. ८७. 8-9.
at a distance of 2 crores of yojanas from Maharlokam;
6: Br. IV. I. १२३; 2. १३-15, १३९. Vi. II. 7. १३-14.
during Pralaya the Devas go from Maharloka to this.
7: Br. I. 6. २८. Vi. VI. 3. २९.
(See also Jana).
(I)--the son of शान्तिदेवा and Vasudeva. Br. III. ७१. १८०.
(II)--a son of Tumba. वा. ९६. २४९.

--here राम vanquished a host of राक्- षसस्;
1: Br. III. ६३. १९५.
and performed the work of gods.
2: वा. ८८. १९४.
[page१-626+ ३७]
--a son of शरूथ; had four sons, पाण्ड्य, केरऌअ, Cola, and Kulya. वा. ९९. 5-6.
--a Deva. Br. II. १३. ९५.
--one of the two पिशाचस्, who met यक्ष, the son of खशा. वा. ६९. ११३.
(I)--a son of Purudvat and भद्रसेना, the Vai- darbhi. Wife of ऐक्ष्वाकी, and son सात्वत. M. ४४. ४५-6.
(II)--a son of Somaka; was killed (before he got an heir? अजमीढ and धूमिनि had to start the line again). M. ५०. १६-19; वा. ९९. २०९.

--a daughter of यातुधान,
1: Br. III. 7. ८५.
married by Aja? (यक्ष्-वा। प्।), one of the sons of खशा; originator of यातुधान clan; hairy in every part.
2: वा. ६९. १२४.
[page१-627+ २९]
--birthday as, fit for गयापिण्ड. वा. १०५. १८.
--a तीर्थम् sacred to पितृस्. M. २२. ४२.

(I)--a great king, son of Hotraka, (Suhotra- वा। प्।) and केशिनी (कौशिका-वा। प्।); while he was performing a sacrifice the गन्गा flowed through his यज्ञवाट; enraged at it he drank the waters; so गन्गा became his daughter and came to be known as जाह्नवी; married कावेरी, the grand-daughter of युवनाश्व; and had a son Sunaha (Suhotra-वा। प्।) by her; father Puru, Sumantu-वि। प्।). भा. IX. १५. 3; Br. III. ६६. २५-30; वा. 1. १४२; ९१. ५४-60; Vi. IV. 7. 3-7.
(II)--eldest son of Somaka. भा. IX. २२. 1; Vi. IV. १९. ७२.
(III)--a son (descendant?) of Kuru, and father of Suratha. भा. IX. २२. 4 and 9; वा. ९९. २१७, २३०; Vi. IV. १९. ७८; २०. 2.
--originated from the son of अष्टक, son of विश्वामित्र. वा. ९१. १०३.
a kingdom of मध्यदेश and a tribe. Br. II. १६. ४०; वा. ४५. १०९; M. ११४. ३४.
--a son of तामस Manu. Br. II. ३०. ४९. Vi. III. 1. १९.

--गन्गा, as the daughter of Janhu, the royal sage;
1: M. १०४. १३; ११०. 7; १८३. ७३; वा. ९१. ५८.
wife of शम्तनु.
2: वा. ९९. २३९.; Vi. IV. २०. ३३; VI. 2. 4.
